svg.title: Combined Ground Station workspace mockups
svg.desc: Four illustrative play-oem workspace arrangements combine the modular Ground Station panels: compact responsive Pass Study, Access Overview, wide Pass Study, and two-station comparison. The compact Pass Study notes a stacked list-over-Sky-View fallback for narrow widths. All plotted data is illustrative.
svg.text: Illustrative arrangements using independent panels; values and plotted data are placeholders.

g.text: A · Pass Study · compact side-by-side when both panels fit
it does not repeat pass history.
Narrow fallback: stack Pass List above Sky View
Show in Sky View · Focus pass · Seek to peak
Select a row to update the linked Sky View.
Station mask · pass path · playback marker
B · Access Overview · current status, interval strip, and elevation
UTC · wraps at north are broken
Shared playback and Plot Range apply to both analysis stacks.
C · Wide Pass Study · table and sky plot side by side
Show in Sky View · Focus pass · Seek to peak
Plot stays independent when Follow selection is off.
Use only when the workspace is wide enough for both table columns and polar axes.
D · Compare Stations · independent station selection, shared time context
Playback and Plot Range are shared; station and selected pass remain stack-local.
